occupation_title: Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand
task_title: Move freight, stock, or other materials to and from storage or production areas, loading docks, delivery vehicles, ships, or containers, by hand or using trucks, tractors, or other equipment.
rationale: Material movement occurs across varied docks, vehicles, ships, storage areas, and production spaces. Powered equipment provides meaningful capability, but representative work includes changing routes, irregular loads, obstacles, and safety accountability that limit occupation-wide automation.
